findings.message: Found '$SPAWN' with '{shell: options.shell}'. This is dangerous because this call will spawn the command using a shell process. Doing so propagates current shell settings and variables, which makes it much easier for a malicious actor to execute commands. Use '{shell: false}' instead.

findings.review_note: runCommand templates command with file and templateData and calls spawn. normalizeOptions defaults shell to true but allows override. The audit rule does not prove shell true on every invocation. command/file data may affect shell text depending on caller template; neither a vulnerability nor a safe call is established for every use. No constant argument proof.
